thread:
alice: Ok team — cutting RC from `release/2026-03-21-minibatch` now. Artifact: rwinf-server:v2.14.0-rc3. No schema changes, just batching + KV warm improvements. Release notes: https://internal.redwood/intranet/release/2026-03-21-minibatch :eyes:

deploy-bot: [ci] build 4281 succeeded — artifact rwinf-server:v2.14.0-rc3 uploaded to registry. Quick checks: unit tests passed, integration smoke queued.

carla: Thanks. Can we pin the embed-service -> v1.8.2 to avoid quantization mismatch? That's what killed the last promo.

alice: Yes, pinning embed-service in the RC config now. I set `embed-service:1.8.2` in the pinfile.

brian: Also flagging DB migration? I don't think this RC touches migrations but we should confirm.

derek: No migrations. Confirmed with the diff. Only runtime parameter changes.

eve: Can we run the smoke on a 5% traffic shim and verify latency p50/p95? I want numbers before promoting.

alice: Good call. Starting canary smoke: `./ops/promote --canary 5 --rc rwinf-server:v2.14.0-rc3`

deploy-bot: [deploy] canary env created in us-west-2. KV warm scheduled. Smoke tests running (job 9932).

carla: Heads-up: telemetry team asked to watch tokenization edge-case metrics (tokenize_failure_rate).

derek: I'll wire up a short eval set. Running prompt-suite v3.2 against canary.

brian: If smoke shows latency regression > 15% p95 we abort and roll back to v2.13.x. Agreed?

eve: +1

alice: Agreed. Also set automatic fallback to v2.13.9 in routing rules during promo window.

deploy-bot: Smoke tests complete. p50: 62ms (baseline 60ms), p95: 420ms (baseline 380ms) — +10.5% (p95). No errors in tokenization suite.

carla: That's within tolerance. Any increase in error rates?

deploy-bot: Error rate: 0.02% (baseline 0.015%) — small blip, within alert threshold but team flagged.

brian: I want a plan if that tokenization blip grows. Quick rollback steps documented?

alice: Rollback runbook: 1) Re-pin routing to `v2.13.9` via routing-api (one-line):
```
curl -X POST https://ops.internal/routing -H 'Authorization: Bearer $OPS' -d '{"service":"rwinf-server","version":"v2.13.9"}'
```
2) Trigger deploy-bot rollback: `/deploy rollback rwinf-server v2.13.9` 3) Notify infra and open incident if >1% error.

derek: Logging hooks are enabled to capture the exact token sequences that fail — I'll collect a sample if anything spikes.

eve: Can we add a KV-warm monitor on cold-start percent? That was the main perf hotspot previously.

carla: Added a dashboard tile and alert: `kv.cold_start_pct > 5% for 5m` -> p95 pager.

alice: Ready for signoff. Who's green? Please react with :thumbsup: in this thread.

brian: :thumbsup: (manual) — good from infra side.

derek: :thumbsup: — telemetry looks sane.

carla: :thumbsup: — pin set, dashboards in place.

eve: :thumbsup: — smoke numbers acceptable.

deploy-bot: [ops] Promotion queued. ETA: 10m. Post-promo checks will run automatically (smoke, token-suite, kv-warm monitor).

alice: Starting promo now. Please stand by for gradual traffic ramp to 100% over 30m with automatic fallback policy.

deploy-bot: Promotion started. Step 1/4: routing shift -> 10% traffic.

carla: Watching logs — nothing unusual.

deploy-bot: Step 2/4: routing shift -> 40% traffic. Smoke OK. kv.cold_start_pct = 1.2%.

derek: Telemetry shows 3 sample tokenization failure traces — but they matched an upstream parsing edge we already have tests for. Low severity.

brian: If error rate rises above 0.5% we trigger the rollback threshold.

deploy-bot: Step 3/4: routing shift -> 75% traffic. No alerts.

alice: At 75% let's pause 5m for observation.

deploy-bot: Paused at 75% for observation window (5m). Post-window: p95 = 410ms, error rate 0.03%.

alice: Clear to finish ramp.

deploy-bot: Step 4/4: routing shift -> 100% traffic. Promotion complete. Release note published: https://internal.redwood/intranet/release/2026-03-21-minibatch/notes

brian: Nice work. I've bookmarked the rollback command and runbook.

carla: Will follow-up with a short postmortem if we see any customer-side anomalies in next 24h.

eve: Shipping 🚀

alice: Thanks everyone. Marking RC -> prod promo complete. If anything odd shows up ping in #incidents and tag me. :party-parrot:
